description_good_justification: README: a PostgreSQL-native search layer for PHP and Symfony (typo-tolerant, accent-insensitive, ranked full-text search) without a separate search service. https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony#readme
interact_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests; contribution guide: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the rules, how to run the checks, and what a pull request needs (tests, CHANGELOG entry, commit style): https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics_justification: README (install, quickstart, query syntax, security, limitations), the docs/ directory (definitions, searching, ranking, languages, sync, multi-tenancy, commands, integrations) and demo/README.md: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony#readme, https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/tree/main/docs
documentation_interface_justification: The README and docs/ document the public API (search builder, index definitions, thresholds, ranking, console commands) with examples: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony#readme, https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/tree/main/docs
sites_https_justification: The project is hosted on GitHub and Packagist, both HTTPS only.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, URL-addressable, no proprietary client needed. https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/issues
english_justification: All documentation, code and issues are in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: releases 0.2.0, 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 in September 2026. https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
repo_track_justification: Git on GitHub records who changed what and when.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is committed and merged to main through pull requests, not only releases.
version_unique_justification: Semantic Versioning with git tags vX.Y.Z: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/tags
version_semver_justification: The CHANGELOG states the project follows Semantic Versioning: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_justification: Keep a Changelog file and GitHub releases: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md, https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: Each release lists fixed vulnerabilities under a Security heading (e.g. 0.3.0): https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported as GitHub issues: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/issues
report_responses_justification: The maintainer responds to bug reports in GitHub issues.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are answered in GitHub issues; accepted ones are added to the README roadmap.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to an acknowledgement within a week: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: composer install; a PHP library needs no compilation.
build_floss_tools_justification: Composer, PHP, PHPUnit, PHPStan and php-cs-fixer are all FLOSS.
test_justification: PHPUnit unit and integration suites, documented in CONTRIBUTING.md (composer test:all).
test_invocation_justification: composer test, composer test:all, composer qa.
test_most_justification: 100% line coverage of src/, tracked on Codecov: https://codecov.io/gh/er2es/fuzzphony
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions on every push and pull request; main only accepts changes whose CI passed: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/actions/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md: every pull request comes with tests and covers the code it adds: https://github.com/er2es/fuzzphony/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes came with tests, e.g. tests/Integration/AccentedStopWordsTest.php for 0.3.1.
warnings_justification: PHPStan (level max, strict rules), php-cs-fixer and PHPUnit failOnWarning/failOnRisky run in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any PHPStan error or style violation; the codebase has none.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies secure design: values are always bound parameters, identifiers come from validated definitions, and the trust model is documented in SECURITY.md.
know_common_errors_justification: SQL injection, XSS and resource exhaustion are handled explicitly: bound values, escaped highlights, and input caps (max_query_length, max_terms, candidate_limit).
crypto_published_justification: Fuzzphony implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_random_justification: No cryptographic keys or nonces are generated.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed through Packagist and GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are retrieved over HTTP.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known unpatched vulnerabilities; the ones found were fixed in 0.3.0 (CHANGELOG, Security).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository contains no credentials; the demo refuses to start exposed with its throwaway defaults.
static_analysis_justification: PHPStan (level max + strict rules) on every push and pull request, CodeQL for the workflows, OpenSSF Scorecard.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: PHPStan strict rules and CodeQL; SQL is built only from validated identifiers and bound values.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: The integration suite runs every query path against real PostgreSQL 15 to 18 in CI.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The test suite checks behaviour with PHPUnit assertions and fails on warnings and risky tests (failOnWarning, failOnRisky).
crypto_used_network_justification: Fuzzphony opens no network connections of its own; the database connection is configured and secured by the application.
crypto_tls12_justification: Fuzzphony opens no network connections of its own; the database connection is configured and secured by the application.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Fuzzphony opens no network connections of its own; the database connection is configured and secured by the application.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: Fuzzphony opens no network connections of its own; the database connection is configured and secured by the application.
